release_notes: Added persistent Adhan volume control with adjustable volume from 0% to 100%.
Added synchronized Adhan volume handling across Windows and Android.
Added persistent volume settings that survive application restart.
Added Adhan notification Stop action to stop the currently playing Adhan without opening the application.
Added Adhan notification interaction to open and restore the application when the notification body is tapped.
Added Adhan Dialog with dedicated Stop Adhan and Close actions.
Improved Adhan playback control with centralized stop handling across notifications and the application.
Improved Android background Adhan playback using the system alarm audio channel.
Improved Adhan notification sound isolation to prevent unwanted system notification sounds.
Improved Adhan playback lifecycle to prevent preview audio from interfering with background Adhan playback.
Improved reciter selection and preview handling with automatic preview cleanup.
Improved background Adhan reliability across Windows and Android.
Hardened Android Adhan volume persistence and native audio preference handling.
Improved Windows System Tray integration for Adhan notification interactions.
Fixed Windows runtime path persistence to prevent scheduled tasks, startup entries, and notification shortcuts from referencing outdated development builds.
Improved Windows installation and runtime state migration when upgrading from previous builds.
Fixed Windows duplicate Adhan playback when the application is running alongside scheduled background Adhan tasks.
Improved Windows Adhan playback ownership between the active application and Task Scheduler to ensure a single Adhan playback per prayer event.
Improved Windows headless Adhan execution to safely yield when the main application instance is already active.
Improved Windows Task Scheduler and Adhan playback synchronization across foreground, tray, and closed-application states.
Fixed Android Release update checks by adding the required Internet permission.
Fixed an issue where network and HTTP errors were incorrectly reported as 'No Update Available'.
Improved update check error handling to clearly distinguish update failures from successful no-update results.
Improved Android update detection and reliability for production Release builds.
Added additional automated tests to verify update detection, failure handling, and version comparison.
Verified the Android Release APK manifest to ensure the required Internet permission is properly packaged.
Improved overall Adhan playback, scheduling, notification, update reliability, stability, and cross-platform prayer experience.
